During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an '''Amani tribe''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]]. The [[Amani/Legends|Amani]] were hostile toward the [[Lurmen/Legends|Lurmen]] settlers led by [[Tee Watt Kaa/Legends|Tee Watt Kaa]].
